title: How is tax calculated on mutual funds
content:
Tax on mutual funds depends on the holding period and fund type.
For Equity Funds (like ELSS or Large Cap): Short Term Capital Gains (held < 1 year) are taxed at 20%. Long Term Capital Gains (held > 1 year) over ₹1.25 Lakh are taxed at 12.5%.
For Debt Funds: Gains are added to your income and taxed at your applicable income tax slab rate regardless of holding period.
